attributes.summary: Ahmadou Ahidjo was the first president of independent Cameroon and held the office from 1960 to 1982.

content.name: Federal structure replaced by a unitary state

attributes.summary: Cameroon replaced its federal structure with a unitary state. The country was renamed the United Republic of Cameroon on 2 June 1972. National Day on 20 May commemorates the change.

source.citation: Gwillim Law, Statoids, Departments of Cameroon, and Wikipedia, Regions of Cameroon. Compiled for this collection and not yet reviewed by a second person.

content.name: Centre-South province divided and Adamawa and Far North created

attributes.summary: The Centre-South province was split into the Centre and South provinces, and the North province was split into three: Adamawa, North and Far North.

attributes.summary: A presidential decree (Décret N° 2008/376 of 12 November 2008) replaced the name province with region for all ten provinces.

content.name: Special status for the Northwest and Southwest regions

attributes.summary: The Northwest and Southwest regions were granted special status that gave them additional powers.
